notes: Variant WLC.2KI.16.18.v004 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base, covering s003; מוּסַךְ is aligned as the covered way, headed on covered under rule 31.
The margin's Or, covered place and Or, round were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed covered way and turned are what is aligned.
The directive he on חִיצוֹנָה shares the adjective's unit under rule 32, the ASV writing the single word without for the pair.

unto the house of Jehovah is read as an accusative of direction under rule 33 rather than as rule 44's supplied preposition, since the clause's objects are the two אֵת-marked nominals already fronted.
